description: Maxwell partner of eos_two_phase: for T < T_c the free energy at rho >= rho_s is replaced by its lower convex hull (linear between rho1(T) and rho2(T), mu = mu_coex, s = Gibbs mixture); identical elsewhere (docs/eos_finite_T.md). REDUCED TEST LATTICE for CI (step 0.2 in x, 0.08 in y).
index_order: p0, T, mu, s: C order, shape (nx, ny), element (ix, iy) at flat index ix*ny + iy (iy fastest); eps_min: shape (ny,) indexed by iy; all float64 little-endian, fields stored consecutively in the order of 'fields'
